item.title: Dental Claim Denial Rates in 2025: The Data Every Practice Needs to See
item.description: Published estimates of dental claim denial rates vary widely, and we did not find a single authoritative national benchmark. Here is what to measure, where denials come from, and how to close the gap before it costs you more.

item.title: How to Audit Dental Payments: A Step-by-Step Guide to Finding What Insurance Owes You
item.description: A dental payment audit is a systematic review of every insurance reimbursement against contracted fees. EDiFi's payment audit engine found $59,000 in underpayments across 2,399 claims. Here's how to run one.

item.title: Dental Eligibility Verification Best Practices: Stop Revenue Leaks Before They Start
item.description: Proper dental insurance eligibility verification requires checking six critical data points before every appointment. Practices that automate this process reduce claim denials by up to 70% and save 8+ hours per week.

item.title: AI Isn't Enough: Why Accelerated Computing Will Decide Which Dental Organizations Win

item.title: How Data Blocks AI in Dental Billing

item.title: The Data Dilemma in Dentistry

item.title: Optimize Your Dental Practice: Compliance, AI, and Staffing Strategies for 2025

item.title: The Life of a Certified Dental Assistant: Tackling Dental Office Workflow Challenges
